thread:
rachel: Quick proposal  run a 6-week "edge-failures" DP track (5 partners). Focus: validate graceful degradation, rollback drills, and partner-side observability during tail incidents. Recruiting: production traffic, debug contact, willing to schedule a rollback drill.

tom: Love the focus. Suggest we require partners to nominate 2 'canary prompts' that represent their worst-case latency/quality tradeoffs. We'll run controlled degradations against those.

ari: Operationally we need a clear cost-sharing model. Proposal: Redwood covers baseline infra; partners can opt into 'reserved burst windows' for predictable SLOs at a discounted slot price split (50/50). Helps partners with budget approvals.

jen: Outreach blurb draft:

"Hi <name> 
We9re piloting an "edge-failures" design partner program to test graceful degradation & rollback flows. 6 weeks, we run controlled drills and share a remediation playbook. Interested? Reply with avg req/s and two candidate prompts.
— Jen"

ops-bot: capacity-check: reserveable_slots=3, est_slot_cost=$4500/mo. Discounted split would be $2250/mo partner share. Run `/reserve slots=1 tag=edge-fail` to allocate.

legal: DP addendum note: include explicit consent for simulated degradations, pause option for partners, and a clear description of rollback triggers. Retention: telemetry stored 30 days.

sylvia: Success criteria: at least 3 partners complete rollback drill within SLAs (crit ack <4h, recovery <15m) AND partner rates playbook usefulness >=8/10. Also require demo of partner-side tracing + alerting integration.

rachel: For feedback capture: short post-drill survey (1-10 usefulness, 3 bullet takeaways) + a one-pager runbook co-authored with partner. We'll keep meetings light: one onboarding, one mid-pilot drill, one wrap.

tom: Important: document expected quality delta when falling back (e.g., compact model -> expected Rouge/accuracy delta) so partners know impact. We'll include sample metrics per prompt.

ari: Timeline & next steps: Jen sends invites by Wed EOD; Ops reserve slot by Fri; Legal drafts addendum by Mon; Sylvia & Tom to draft runbook template by Tue. Any blockers?

jen: I'll start outreach today.

legal: I'll draft the addendum and share comments in the doc.
